draft.title: Training the Stolarnia Pod Jodłą team in AI tools for quotes, offers and visualisations
draft.summary: Stolarnia Pod Jodłą, a micro-enterprise making custom furniture, plans to train its seven-person team in AI tools for preparing quotes, offer descriptions and simple visualisations. The training can be co-financed under the Usługi rozwojowe 7.4A FEDS project if it is selected from the Development Services Database (BUR).

sections.heading: Development need
sections.body:
The company (7 people) makes custom furniture. Quotes and drawings are prepared by the owner in the evenings. The team is to learn to use AI tools for quotes, offer descriptions and simple visualisations.

[To complete: how many offers the company prepares per month and how long one takes.]

sections.heading: Scope of development services
sections.body:
1. Training in AI tools for offer descriptions and customer correspondence.
2. Training in preparing quotes with AI tools.
3. Training in simple furniture visualisations with AI tools.

Only services listed in the Development Services Database (BUR) are co-financed. [To complete: selected BUR services and their providers.]

sections.heading: Results
sections.body:
Employees other than the owner prepare quotes and offer descriptions with the help of AI tools.

[To complete: number of people trained, and baseline and target time to prepare an offer.]

sections.heading: Budget and schedule
sections.body:
Usługi rozwojowe 7.4A FEDS: 50–70% co-financing, up to PLN 10k net per service and PLN 28k per agreement.
